d:
Bihar ke bhagalpur sthit bhartiy suchna praudyogiki sansthan yani IIIT ke honharon ne apni mehnat se saphalta ki naee ibarat likhi hai.sansthan ke 2023-27 baich ke vidyarthiyon ko desh ki diggaj maltineshnal kanpniyon men 47 lakh se lekar 60 lakh rupye salana tak ka shandar paikej mila hai.
